thread:
anya: Quick idea — can we add a small 'deploy-helper' surface in the deploy bot plus a couple script templates? we're spending too much time on manual pin/rollback/release-note boilerplate.

sam: +1. concrete proposal: add a --dry-run flag and a --window flag to /deploy, and a /deploy template command that emits a release-note skeleton.

juan: Example flags i'd love: `/deploy dry-run --pin web@v2.3.1 --window '2026-04-02T02:00Z/1h'` — dry-run should validate routing, manifests, and migration hooks but not touch prod.

mike: Need idempotent rollback semantics. `/deploy rollback --to web@v2.3.0 --reason "regression" --force` should do a safety check: are migrations backward compatible? if not, error out.

deploy-bot: [bot] noted. current supported flags: --canary --pin --no-cache. i'll add --dry-run and --window to the bot API and expose /deploy template. will post PR link when ready. :white_check_mark:

anya: Also drafting a tiny repo-level script engineers can copy — reduces pushing ad-hoc one-offs. snippet: 

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# small wrapper to call deploy bot via infra CLI
SERVICE="$1"
TAG="$2"
PIN="$3"
WINDOW="$4"
DRYRUN="$5"

./infra/cli deploy \  \
  --service "$SERVICE" \  \
  --tag "$TAG" \  \
  $( [ "$PIN" = "true" ] && echo "--pin" ) \  \
  $( [ -n "$WINDOW" ] && echo "--window \"$WINDOW\"" ) \  \
  $( [ "$DRYRUN" = "true" ] && echo "--dry-run" )

# usage: ./scripts/rwd-deploy web v2.3.1 true "2026-04-02T02:00Z/1h" false
```

sam: nice. also add a guard so pinning requires approvals: `/deploy --pin --approval 'pm,eng-lead'` — bot should fail if approvals missing and show approvers list.

juan: For release notes, how about `/deploy template --pr-list <prs>` that outputs a checklist + changelog skeleton:

```
- Summary: one-line summary of change
- Motivation: why this matters
- Rollout plan: canary % and change window
- Migration notes: db changes, required infra updates
- Smoke checks: endpoints and metrics to watch (error rate, p95 latency)
- Rollback plan: exact command to revert
```

mike: On the ops side, can we have the bot run quick metric diffs after canary (error rate and p95) and add a pass/fail indicator to the deploy thread? reduces manual eyeballing. :eyes:

anya: also `/deploy summarize <thread_ts>` that composes the release note from merged PR titles and the template above would be very helpful. attach to the changelog automatically on success.

deploy-bot: [bot] created infra issue #432 to track: add --dry-run, --window, --approval flow, template and summarize endpoints, and metric-check hooks. starting with dry-run + window flags. :spiral_notepad:

sam: i'll take the bot PR (tests + integration). will also add a lint rule preventing pin on main without at least two approvers.

anya: sweet. can we aim to land the CLI wrapper + bot changes before next release window (2026-04-10)? if not, fall back to a documented template in /docs/deploy-helpers.

juan: I'll add the release-note skeleton to the docs and a short howto for rollback safety checks.

mike: ping me on the PR for metric thresholds. i can wire the prometheus queries.

anya: thanks team — this should shave 10-15m off each rollout and reduce mistakes. :rocket:
